The '''Chortose''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Chortose/Legends|same name]]. They were covered in fur and had long, pointy [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. The [[Goo brothers]] were Chortose siblings who lived and worked in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. These brothers had an innate ability to repair [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and were able to complete a job faster than trained [[Technician/Legends|technicians]].

==Biology and appearance==
The Chortose were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chortose/Legends|Chortose]]. They had two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a broad [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and two long, pointy [[Ear/Legends|ears]]. The Chortose were covered in [[Hair/Legends|fur]]&mdash;apart from their nose and ears&mdash;with longer tufts of fur forming eyebrows and beards. They had two [[Limb/Legends|arms]], which ended in fingers capable of manipulating tools. The Chortose [[Porgo Goo]], one of the [[Goo brothers]], was short and plump, and wore suspenders over his other clothing.<ref name="GG6" />

==Society and culture==
Porgo Goo was a playful and sociable Chortose, particularly enjoying meetings in dangerous [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]]. He lacked a formal education, although he was not embarrassed by that fact. All the Goo brothers enjoyed a challenge, working extra hard if appropriately motivated.<ref name="GG6" />

==History==
The Chortose were from Chortose,<ref name="GG6" /> located in the [[Rseik sector/Legends|Rseik sector]] of the southern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Goo brothers operated a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] repair yard in the neighboring [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. Although never formally trained as [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], the Goos discovered an intuitive understanding of mechanical devices. They proved exceptionally efficient, able to complete repairs up to three times faster than orthodox trained [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], if given the right motivation&mdash;typically bets or dares as opposed to [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The Goos had no compunction with installing devices outlawed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], provided that the items took their fancy.<ref name="GG6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chortose were created by [[Mark Rein-Hagen]] and [[Stewart Wieck]] for the [[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters|first edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1990]]. The sole illustration of a Chortose is by [[Allen Nunis]].
